# 2) JOIN : [["Source6_54_0", "Source6_54_1"], ["Source6_54_0.state", "Source6_54_1.County/City"]]

# 4) JOIN : [["Source6_54_0", "Source6_54_1"], ["Source6_54_0.state", "Source6_54_1.County/City"]]

    left_on="state",
